betaInfo.experimental: This dashboard is experimental — charts and metrics may change between releases.
betaInfo.integrations: Works with traces from the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions, OpenLLMetry, OpenInference, and the Vercel AI SDK. No ingestion changes needed — spans are interpreted at query time.
betaInfo.costEstimates: Costs are estimates from a bundled model price catalog and can lag provider pricing. A cost reported by the instrumentation itself always takes precedence.
betaInfo.deduplication: When an app emits several instrumentations for the same calls, spans reporting their own cost are counted once as the source of truth.

emptyState.title: No LLM spans found
emptyState.description: No spans with LLM instrumentation were found in the selected time range. This dashboard works with traces emitted by OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions, OpenLLMetry, OpenInference, or the Vercel AI SDK — point that instrumentation at your existing OTLP endpoint and LLM calls will show up here automatically.
